reviewContext.issueReference: local:impl-plans/active/modular-audio-foundation.md#MOD-004 (MOD-004: arbitrary stereo and multi-output UGen edges; workflow opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-189, plan review comm-002455)
reviewContext.userProblem: Edge carries only from/to/port, so lowering cannot name which output of a source node feeds an input. Each compiled node renders one mono buffer. As a result, 36 prelude templates instantiate an engine twice to recover main and aux, stereo sampler output cannot stay stereo through UGen edges, voice-local effects downmix stereo, and main/aux voices bypass ordinary pan mapping (design-mutable-audio.md#stereo-and-multi-output-ugen-edges-mod-004, Problem).
requiredOutcomes: Every UGen node declares bounded typed outputs (mono or stereo, up to 4 outputs, up to 2 channels each), and Edge gains an output index (MOD004-10).

.vact selects outputs by calling the node value with an output keyword (p :aux) or an index (p 1). Invalid selection is a definition-time diagnostic, and an unselected use means output 0. The static checker types (ugen kw|int) as ugen (MOD004-20).
Shape, voice-layout and 512-slice capacity errors are definition-time lowering errors (MOD004-20), and template build returns BuildError::TooManyBuffers (MOD004-22).

Dense, bounded channel-slice voice buffers. Pair kernels and sample::play_stereo are used only when output 1 is consumed. Stereo Mul/Add and stereo voice-local effects do not downmix. Stereo and main/aux voices use unity-center balance pan; mono voices keep equal-power pan (MOD004-11, MOD004-12, MOD004-22).

The graph codec uses the new instrument tag b'V', one shape byte per node and one output byte per edge, and cross-checks shapes on decode with no allocation. The old tag b'I' is rejected with BadRecord (MOD004-21).
Exactly nine simultaneous-output templates migrate to one node with (p :main)/(p :aux), each bit-identical to its old two-node form (MOD004-30).
Every unmigrated prelude template renders bit-identically to the golden digests captured at cf2ea37 (MOD004-00 baseline, re-checked in every wave).
Native and browser installs give identical compiled shapes and renders. Callback allocation probes pass, and the rate/block invariance tests pass (MOD004-40).
MOD-004A..F criteria are checked off in impl-plans/active/modular-audio-foundation.md with a dated progress log (MOD004-40).
nonGoals: Dynamic channel counts, unbounded output lists, surround layouts or implicit up/downmix matrices.
A legacy graph-payload decoder, or mixed-revision native/browser compatibility.
Changes to bus/master processing, out3/out4 stems, or mono pan.
Grammar or reader changes (no dot syntax), and a validate_ugen_output in src/ns/insts.rs.
Migrating any template beyond the nine listed. phase-pair-voice, resonator-voice and the other excluded templates stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
Mutable source parity certification, and archiving the parent plan (MOD-005/006 remain).
constraints: Follow the committed design and the owner decisions resolved on 2026-09-29; do not reopen them.
Write only under src/, tests/, examples/, design-docs/, impl-plans/, verification/ and tmp/, and only within each plan's writePaths.
The audio callback stays allocation-free and bounded. decode_graph and template build must not allocate. Native and wasm32 behave identically.
Every touched Rust file stays under 1000 lines.
Use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true for cargo and NEXTEST_STATUS_LEVEL=fail NEXTEST_FAILURE_OUTPUT=immediate-final NEXTEST_HIDE_PROGRESS_BAR=1 for nextest.
Commits use the AGENTS.md numbered 1-6 sections with no Co-Authored-By or tool attribution; do not push.
The golden fixture is blessed once in MOD004-00. Only MOD004-30 may regenerate it, and only the nine migrated templates' graph lines; no plan may change a render line.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Selector spelling is a call with a keyword or index, because it needs no grammar change. The evaluator-only UGenKind::Output(k) wrapper lowers to edge output k, and memoizing the inner node by Rc pointer makes (p :main) and (p :aux) one node.

Shapes are always derived from per-kind OutputDecl (Fixed, FollowSubject, Elementwise, Control, Tap) and never stored in InstDef or RawGraph. One shared set of allocation-free functions (derive_shapes, voice_layout, assign_slices) in src/dsp/graph/shape.rs keeps lowering, decoder and template build in agreement.
Balance pan is unity at center (balance_gains(0.5) == (1.0, 1.0)), so legacy aux-out voices stay bit-identical at center pan.
Pair kernels run only when output 1 is consumed. Otherwise the unchanged legacy function runs, so unmigrated templates stay bit-identical by construction.
A new instrument tag (b'V') is the permitted discriminator, so old payloads fail with BadRecord instead of being misparsed.
sample-play's shape is fixed per kind ([mono, stereo]) and not derived from the resource, so the per-event bank choice in the prelude sampler keeps its sound.
Voice-local effects follow the subject's shape, so existing mono voice effects stay bit-identical. Unconsumed outputs go to discard slices instead of being rejected.
intentionalTradeoffs: Same-branch fanout without worktrees. Concurrent workers in waves 1 and 2 may briefly break crate-wide compilation; this is mitigated by the retry protocol and serial reconciliation in MOD004-40.
The engine.rs render path is split first (MOD004-11) purely to keep files under 1000 lines, at the cost of one extra wave-1 plan.
Old template forms stay valid, and duplicate-node templates outside the nine keep duplicated state and work.

If block-partition bit-identity (MOD004-40 case 2) also fails for the legacy two-node form, the result is recorded as pre-existing, and the plan asserts equivalence plus the existing rate_contract bounds instead.
supportedEdgeCases: Index 0 selection still returns a wrapper, so selecting from a selection ((p :aux) :main) fails with not-callable.
A root (p :aux) lowers to an identity Add sink fed by output 1.
(s :stereo) + {x > aux-out}: derive_shapes accepts it, and voice_layout rejects it with StereoAuxOut.
A stereo source into a mono-only port (for example lpf) is a definition-time Mismatch error.
Control (Const/Param) and Tap sources broadcast to both channels of an Elementwise stereo node.
An unconsumed VaFilter aux writes to discard slices, and the legacy path is used.
Capacity: 205-node SamplePlay/Add tree (513 slices) gives TooManyBuffers; 203 nodes (508 slices) build as a stereo voice; 256 mono nodes build.
Codec: shape byte with bit 6 set, a shape that disagrees with the kind, edge output out of range, and stereo into Lpf all give BadRecord.
play_stereo with a 1-channel resource writes mono to both sides; a missing resource zero-fills all outputs and finishes like play.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: More than 4 outputs per node, or more than 2 channels per output.
Output selection inside bus bodies (rejected with a lowering error, not supported).
phase_pair, spectrum_pair, grain_pair and seeded kernels as multi-output nodes.
